vellum_obligation: The image file cache must report its entry cap through a read-only accessor that returns the value set_capacity() stored, so a caller that changes the cap can restore the one it found.
evidence: ctest --test-dir build -R 'ImageCacheCapacityGuard restores the capacity it found'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'ImageFileCache: capacity\(\) reads back the entry cap'
